_layer: STATIC — the 5 shots, fixed order. {placeholders} are filled from the dynamic layer.

shots.purpose: Shopify main image: the product alone, exactly as it is, shot in our in-house studio
shots.camera: same angle as the main real photo (usually straight-on front or the photo's own 3/4 turn), eye level to 15 degrees above; 85-100mm product lens
shots.framing: product centred, 65-75% of the frame, whole product visible, at least 8% margin
shots.set: clean seamless backdrop in {hero_backdrop}, soft contact shadow, nothing else on the set
shots.props: 0-2 small, plain, real studio objects only (e.g. a blank paper sheet, a plain ceramic dish, a sprig of greenery), placed at the edges, out of focus, never touching or covering the product
shots.depth_of_field: deep - the whole product tack sharp

shots.mode_rule: if category.material_is_visual = true -> MACRO; else -> FEATURE CALLOUT

macro.camera: move the camera closer to the approved hero; same angle, same light
macro.framing: a close-up of a part that is clearly visible in the real photos ({detail_focus}: logo patch, print, texture, tip, zip) filling 60-80% of the frame
macro.set: the same backdrop and light as the hero, very shallow depth of field

feature_callout.camera: same angle as the approved hero on the plain {hero_backdrop}
feature_callout.framing: product 45-55% on one side, clean space on the other for text added later
feature_callout.set: plain backdrop; no text, labels or icons in the image

shots.purpose: the product where and how it is really used, as if photographed on our own desk or set
shots.camera: 30-45 degrees above or top-down flat lay; the product keeps the same face and orientation as the approved hero
shots.framing: product 40-55% of the frame and the sharpest, brightest element
shots.human: {human_mode}: real, natural hands only if the brand allows; hands never cover the logo, print or text
shots.props: 2-3 plain, unbranded, real everyday objects that make sense for the use (blank notebook, plain pencil, paper sheet, ceramic cup); no logos, no other products of any brand
shots.depth_of_field: medium — background softly out of focus

shots.purpose: the brand mood: a styled, realistic scene in which the product is clearly the subject
shots.camera: 30-60 degrees or top-down; editorial but realistic; the product keeps the same face and orientation as the approved hero
shots.framing: product 30-45% of the frame on a rule-of-thirds point, 15-25% calm negative space
shots.props: 3-4 plain, unbranded, real objects in colours that match the product or brand palette (coloured paper blocks, a plant, a plain mug, a wooden ruler); no logos, no other products of any brand
shots.depth_of_field: shallow — background and outer props soft
